presets.name: 薄荷青巧斜纹
presets.css: /* Puff · 薄荷青巧  即时对话主题模板 *//* 聊天页叠色变量 */.chat-thread {  --dress-chat-bg-overlay: transparent;}/* 彻底清除所有消息容器、外框及气泡的外部灰色阴影 */.chat-msg,.chat-msg-inner,.chat-msg-body,.chat-msg-content,.chat-msg-main,.chat-msg-wrapper,.chat-bubble {  box-shadow: none !important;  background-color: transparent;}/* 顶栏胶囊 */.chat-thread-pill {  background: rgba(218, 244, 234, 0.90) !important;  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.40) !important;  border-radius: 999px !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), inset 0 3px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20) !important;  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) !important;  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) !important;  color: #3d251e !important;}.chat-thread-center h2 {  color: #3d251e !important;  font-size: 15px !important;  font-weight: 500 !important;}.chat-thread-pill .chat-back,.chat-thread-head-more,.chat-thread-head-xinsheng {  color: #3d251e !important;  background: transparent !important;}/* 暗色模式 - 顶栏 */html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-thread-pill {  background: rgba(28, 18, 14, 0.90) !important;  border-color: rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.18) !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;  color: #b7e4c7 !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-thread-center h2 {   color: #b7e4c7 !important; }html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-thread-pill .chat-back,html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-thread-head-more,html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-thread-head-xinsheng {  color: #b7e4c7 !important;}/* 昵称 / 时间 */.chat-msg-name {  font-size: 11px !important;  opacity: 0.72 !important;}.chat-msg-timestamp,.chat-thread-notice {  color: #8aab9b !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-msg-timestamp,html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-thread-notice {  color: rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.55) !important;}/* 对方气泡：薄荷绿 + 斜纹 + 顶部亮白高光线条（和我方白线完全同等亮度） */.chat-msg.is-them .chat-bubble {  background: #c2ead5 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(58, 34, 24, 0.045) 8px, rgba(58, 34, 24, 0.045) 9px) !important;  color: #281711 !important;  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) !important;  border-radius: 22px 22px 22px 6px !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), inset 0 3px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;}/* 我方气泡：可可渐变斜纹 + 顶部亮白高光线条 */.chat-msg.is-me .chat-bubble {  background-color: #3a2218 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 8px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 9px), linear-gradient(140deg, #4d3327 0%, #3a2218 55%, #2e1a12 100%) !important;  color: #f0f5f2 !important;  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) !important;  border-radius: 22px 22px 6px 22px !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), inset 0 3px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;}.chat-bubble-primary {  line-height: 1.55 !important;}/* 暗色模式 - 气泡 */html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-msg.is-them .chat-bubble {  background: #1c3829 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.06) 8px, rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.06) 9px) !important;  color: #d8f3dc !important;  border-color: rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.12) !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-msg.is-me .chat-bubble {  background-color: #291812 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 8px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 9px), linear-gradient(140deg, #3d271e 0%, #291812 55%, #1f1109 100%) !important;  color: #e2f4eb !important;  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;}/* 引用块 */.chat-qq-quote {  opacity: 0.90 !important;  border-left: 3px solid #6fcf97 !important;}.chat-qq-quote-name {  font-size: 11px !important;  opacity: 0.75 !important;  color: #4aad78 !important;}.chat-qq-quote-text {  font-size: 12px !important;}/* 转账 / 红包卡片 */.puff-transfer,.chat-msg .puff-transfer {  background: #c2ead5 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(58, 34, 24, 0.045) 8px, rgba(58, 34, 24, 0.045) 9px) !important;  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) !important;  border-radius: 20px !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), inset 0 3px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;  color: #281711 !important;}.puff-transfer-badge {  background: rgba(58, 34, 24, 0.07) !important;  color: #3d251e !important;}.puff-transfer-k {  color: #4a6e5d !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .puff-transfer {  background: #1c3829 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.06) 8px, rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.06) 9px) !important;  border-color: rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.12) !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;  color: #d8f3dc !important;}/* 语音条 */.chat-msg.is-them .puff-voice-pill {  background: #c2ead5 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(58, 34, 24, 0.045) 8px, rgba(58, 34, 24, 0.045) 9px) !important;  color: #281711 !important;  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) !important;  border-radius: 999px !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), inset 0 3px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;}.chat-msg.is-me .puff-voice-pill {  background-color: #3a2218 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 8px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 9px), linear-gradient(120deg, #4d3327, #3a2218) !important;  color: #f0f5f2 !important;  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) !important;  border-radius: 999px !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), inset 0 3px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-msg.is-them .puff-voice-pill {  background: #1c3829 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.06) 8px, rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.06) 9px) !important;  color: #d8f3dc !important;  border-color: rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.12) !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-msg.is-me .puff-voice-pill {  background-color: #291812 !important;  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 8px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 9px), linear-gradient(120deg, #3d271e, #291812) !important;  color: #e2f4eb !important;  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;}/* 翻译展开 */.chat-bubble-trans-inline,.chat-bubble-trans-chip {  opacity: 0.88 !important;}.chat-bubble-trans-chip-label {  font-size: 10px !important;  opacity: 0.65 !important;}/* 气泡旁「推演」 */.chat-thinking-chip {  background: rgba(58, 34, 24, 0.07) !important;  color: #7a6358 !important;  border-radius: 999px !important;  padding: 2px 10px !important;  font-size: 11px !important;  letter-spacing: 0.04em !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-thinking-chip {  background: rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.10) !important;  color: #8ac9a8 !important;}/* 输入胶囊 */.chat-compose-bar {  background: rgba(222, 245, 235, 0.90) !important;  color: #3d251e !important;  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.50) !important;  border-radius: 999px !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.70) !important;  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) !important;  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) !important;}.chat-compose-plus {  color: #5a8a72 !important;  background: transparent !important;}.chat-compose-icon.is-voice,.chat-compose-icon.is-reply {  color: #5a8a72 !important;}.chat-compose-icon.is-send.ready {  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4d3327, #3a2218) !important;  color: #f0f5f2 !important;}.chat-compose-input {  color: #3d251e !important;}/* 暗色模式 - 输入框 */html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-compose-bar {  background: rgba(28, 18, 14, 0.90) !important;  border-color: rgba(168, 218, 195, 0.15) !important;  box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;  color: #d8f3dc !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-compose-plus,html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-compose-icon.is-voice,html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-compose-icon.is-reply {  color: #7abf9a !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-compose-icon.is-send.ready {  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3d271e, #291812) !important;  color: #e2f4eb !important;}html[data-theme="dark"] .chat-compose-input {  color: #d8f3dc !important;}
